purpose: Evaluate two unchanged artist retrieval arms against five separately collected historical human style attributes on DEVELOPMENT folds0..3 only; reserve original fold4 for a separately frozen future style-model confirmation. No model/index optimization or recommendation/relevance claim.

pre_freeze_knowledge.known: Previous human-genre classification/calibration and PR86 genre-coherence outcomes; source identities and exact selected-style spelling/availability/support counts. These five style attributes were preselected before style-coherence outcomes; happy excluded because previously used. One count-only support census, no rank-based style metrics or choices among alternate folds/attributes.
not_computed: fold4 style artist fractions or scores in this slice
pre_freeze_knowledge.reservation: Counts for all five folds were seen during feasibility, but no style-coherence outcomes were computed. Label-held-out, transductive target reservation, not an untouched covariate cohort or inductive validation.

source.required_inputs: Only pinned retained metadata/human bytes, frozen source identity/canonicalization helpers and externally pinned old feature-only reconstruction evidence. No NB/T models, old predictions or additional human labels; selected style parsing skips fold4 before vote extraction.

frozen_retrieval.geometry: Reconstruct exactly the frozen five original gallery-only TF-IDF banks and COMPLETE positive-cosine orders, with unchanged sorted dense float64 matrix equations, scores and native component/artist ties. No new feature weighting, selection, vocabulary or IDF roles. Verify all20 original unit-matrix hashes, exact indices/rankings payload hashes and all713 original full-top10 outcomes before any style grading. Only feature/native identity inputs to reconstruction; no targets/masks. Original modules remain unchanged.
frozen_retrieval.covariate_caveat: For development query folds0..3, the pre-existing other-four-fold gallery geometry includes unlabeled fold4 metadata. Do not silently refit/restrict IDF or claim inductive isolation. Future style model must separately freeze and build train-only feature context before any reserved fold4 style evaluation.

identity: Replay full native metadata/human identity join before parsing targets. Build artist+album connected components over all11565 native metadata tracks, component minimum track ID, before target support filtering. Preserve713artists/components and2365albums; assert one native artist per component for these exact bytes. No name/fuzzy/alias joins; native identity isolation cannot prove different musicians or absence of duplicate audio.

folds.roles: Apply native identity ROLE MASK BEFORE selected-style parsing/profile aggregation. No fold4 selected-style fractions in memory, census payload, profiles, scores, support gates or bootstrap. Reserved per-artist identity/status and frozen count-only summaries allowed. Query foldf development artist vs development artists of other folds; exclude own whole component and every fold4 identity. Preserve all713 old proof outcomes separately; only558 development query outcomes per arm are style-evaluable, with 155 explicit reserved statuses.

human_targets.eligibility: Exactly3 recognized literal tokens for each attribute, including disagreements; no aliases/casing/normalization. Missing, invalid and wrong-count remain explicit and are never negatives. Never inspect any additional human attributes.
human_targets.artist_probability: Per development artist/attribute, equal mean over eligible track positive-vote fractions (positive count/3); do not weight by all metadata tracks or annotated albums. Complete target means >=1 eligible track in EVERY fixed attribute. Preserve all development track reasons; fold4 has reserved status only.
human_targets.primary: All547 complete development artist query components, regardless of feature support or retrieval availability.
human_targets.secondary: Predeclared446 development query components with >=2 eligible tracks in EACH attribute; same complete development gallery as primary, not a different candidate pool.
human_targets.separation: Only evaluator receives targets/availability. Human values or masks never change geometry, raw cosine order or role eligibility. Expected agreement functional assumes independent draws; annotator independence is not established.

evaluation_gate.requirements: Development complete query count>=100; each of all4 development galleries>=50 all-five-complete artists AND >=5 artists with any positive source vote AND >=5 with any explicit negative source vote for EVERY fixed attribute.
evaluation_gate.failure: Any attribute/fold support failure marks ENTIRE macro study unsupported before new style score execution; no dropped attribute, fold, query, reseed or substitute method. Source/custody/identity/runtime failure aborts atomically.

ranking_evaluation.order: From complete unchanged positive-cosine order: first filter development role eligibility (exclude fold4 and own query fold/component), THEN filter complete-five-target availability for condensed judged top10. No reranking, zero-score fillers or fallback. Role-filtered full DEV top10 is the positive order after ROLE filter only, before target-complete mask.
ranking_evaluation.full_catalog: Preserve old full713 outcomes byte-exact as historical proof. In full-CATALOG coverage accounting, fold4 neighbors are RESERVED separately from ordinary unjudged and missing. Never grade full-catalog top10 using fold4 style targets.
ranking_evaluation.coverage: For development-role fulltop10 record judged/unjudged/missing slots separately. Conditional observed agreement over judged returned neighbors only, null if none; never count unjudged as negative or compute an asserted full-gallery style score.

metrics.attribute_gain: g_j(q,c)=q_j*c_j+(1-q_j)*(1-c_j). Explicit positive term q_j*c_j and negative term (1-q_j)*(1-c_j), total=sum; equal macro over ALL5 attributes.
metrics.primary: Candidate-minus-genre mean condensed development-judged macro expected agreement@10: sum returned gains/10, missing ranks contribute0 only as absent slots; query denominator ALL547 regardless of empty profile/no overlap. No discount/IDCG/NDCG in this style endpoint.
metrics.random: Exact uniform-random expected agreement against SAME complete development gallery: arithmetic mean gain over all gallery targets, not sampled rankings. Galleries all>=50 so expected fixed-denominator top10 mean equals gallery mean. Same decomposition per attribute/macro.
metrics.secondary: Same complete gallery and outcomes,446 >=2-track-per-attribute query subset. Three paired comparisons: candidate-minus-genre, genre-minus-random, candidate-minus-random.
metrics.prevalence: Report artist-equal query and gallery positive probability and its complement per attribute/macro, denominators and track support; positive-positive and negative-negative contributions beside total, so majority-negative agreement cannot masquerade as positive coherence.
metrics.diagnostics: Report ALL4 development folds and ALL5 attributes plus macro, both arms and random, positive/negative/total; predefined query instrument-present/absent strata from any native metadata instrument tag. No selected winning attribute/fold/stratum. Retain complete/incomplete/reserved artist counts and full source track-reason availability.

bootstrap.unit: Paired development query COMPONENT resampling with replacement, fixed galleries/indices/orders/targets. Identical query draws reused across all5 attributes+macro, positive/negative/total and all3 pair comparisons within each cohort.
bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive reused-cohort fixed-gallery intervals, not independent-population, retraining, annotator independence or fresh confirmatory evidence.

architecture: Separate count-only source/identity/role/availability census externally sealed BEFORE new style metric math. Numeric run/replay reconstruct old frozen feature-only banks and prove old full artifact equality, then role-filter and evaluate development-only human targets. Atomic fresh closed-inventory artifacts, external protocol/census/result pins, exact physical file hashes/sizes and targeted implementation/numerical runtime pins. No supervised fit/train/partial_fit calls, old NB/T models or source network access.

accounting.note: Five unchanged unsupervised reconstruction banks per run and replay separately;0 supervised fits, no selected new feature geometry. Counts-only census0 index builds. Existing retained source bytes reused,0 acquisition/$0.

rights.commit_policy: Only code, protocol and restrained attributed aggregates committed. Native profiles, ranks, target ledger, source and index artifacts remain local noncommercial research data. No UI/default/serving/deployment integration.

interpretation: Prospectively frozen DEVELOPMENT style-outcome evaluation on historical reused cohort/annotation process, not fresh cohort, listening relevance, recommendation utility, actual inter-annotator agreement, artist membership, EveryNoise parity or automatic model promotion. Label-held-out transductive fold4 reservation has count-only preinspection and known covariates, not full untouched data. Any future style candidate/feature bank/confirmation protocol must be separately frozen before reserved style labels are aggregated/scored.
